terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Static fence panel that tiles post to post. Both faces are seen and nothing is hollow, but nothing opens, turns or swings, so every part is fixed and one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract. A level builder places these in runs of dozens, so the draw-call ceiling is the design constraint. ONE POST PER TILE: the post sits on the -X end and the bay runs to the +X edge, so tiles chain post-bay-post-bay along X with no doubled post at a joint. Lot boundaries, school yards, substation compounds. Galvanised wire dulled grey with rust at the ties, rust-streaked posts, mesh sagging at the bottom edge, dry weeds at the footings.

reasoning: ONE galvanised pipe post with a cap on the -X end, a top rail to the next tile's post centre, a diamond mesh from 0.22 to 1.92 m as ONE alpha-cut pane, a bottom tension wire sagging 0.08 m, and a 0.26 m concrete footing under the post (proxy: posts 4 of 80 columns full height, footings 0.00-0.10 H at 8 columns, rail at 0.98 H, mesh 0.14-0.92 H).

Three materials: galvanised steel with a rust canvas, the alpha-tested mesh pane, and footing concrete with a grime canvas. The registry notes require the mesh as an alpha-cut texture on a single plane -- a prop kit for low-end PCs cannot afford wire geometry.
No repetition system: the mesh cells are the canvas tile repeated 46 x 26 across the pane, not instances.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one box collider on the posts root, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is see-through diamond mesh between two pipes with a sag at the bottom; the mesh is a repeated alpha-cut cell, the sag and the footings are geometry.

preSpecAssessment.unknownsResolutionNote: Emptied because every entry has been RESOLVED with a recorded authoring decision, not because the gaps went away. Each is restated in assumptions and in viewEvidence with its confidence and a null path. Nothing was invented to close a gap.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 3.00 x 2.00 x 0.08 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=4000 triangles, <=4 draw calls, <=3 materials, <=6 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot and zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material declares textureless with named evidence.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.85. 486/4,000 triangles, 3/4 draw calls, 3/3 materials, 3/6 unique geometries, three canvases at 0.8 MB. Turntable: the mesh is open by nature, allowed on measurement; 90/270 are UNSEGMENTABLE by size (posts and footings under 2% of frame against the segmenter's 3.5% floor), recorded as a gate limitation of every 3 m panel.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the large class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

drawCalls.note: Three components, no repetition system: 3 of 4.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 486 of 4,000: five cylinders, a nine-segment tube, one quad and one box.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Cylinders for the pipe and collars, a polyline tube for the sagging wire, one quad for the mesh, a box for the footing.
No InstancedMesh: the mesh repeats as a canvas tile, not as instances.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Every material is declared textureless. Three canvases after construction (256, 128 alpha, 256 px), 0.8 MB of texture VRAM.

risks.description: At 90 and 270 degrees the panel is one 0.06 m post over a 0.26 m footing, under 2% of the frame; the turntable segmenter needs 3.5% and reports those azimuths unsegmented.
risks.mitigation: A property of every 3 m panel; 0 and 180 segment (0.115 / 0.053 of frame, the back darker through the double-sided pane). Recorded, not bypassed.

risks.description: An alpha-tested 1-2 px wire thins at distance as mipmaps average the cell toward transparent.
risks.mitigation: Bold 0.11-cell wire in a 128 px tile; the mesh reads as a grey veil at distance, which is what chain-link does.
